name: Zenithal-Antiphon
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by a nearby asteroid belt. Farther poleward, past magnetic pole anomalies, the silence feels older than the soil.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
